result:
I applied B's fix for C-R241-01. After a right-click opens the grid menu, focus now goes back to the Snap toggle when the menu closes, instead of being lost. Every check I ran passed except the first browser attempt, which timed out on environment. There was no STOP.

**What changed (only the three files the task allows):**
- **`StudioWorkspace.tsx`:** I applied B's pre-checked diff exactly. A right-button press on the lane now remembers which element had focus before the browser drops it. That element is used only if nothing is focused when the menu opens. Nothing else in the file was touched.
- **`grid-snap-menu.test.tsx`:** added four tests (GM36–GM39) and one helper at the end; no existing line was removed.
- **Doc 186:** made the status line, title, R6/R8, "ეტაპი 1:" prefix, Problem → Solution, testing and file-list edits the task asks for. I also corrected one sentence after the review so it matches the code exactly.

After all edits the tree is still exactly the expected 14 changed files. The 1,101 frozen files and the 4 root files still match their recorded hashes.

**Checks:**
- **Static:** typecheck, lint and Biome on the two code files are clean.
- **Tests:** the 61 covering test files pass (1,077 tests). The slowest test took 3.7 s against a 20 s limit, so none is near half its timeout.
- **Mutants:** I ran both on a scratch copy outside the repo. Removing the press capture turns GM36, GM37 and GM39 red. Making the press-time element always win turns GM38 red. The repo's status was identical before and after.
- **Browser (Chromium on :5173):**
  - The first attempt timed out waiting for the demo to load. That was a cold dev-server start, so I kept it as environment-invalid evidence.
  - On the second attempt, all 6 cases ended on the Snap toggle: Escape, `0.5 s` and `Narrow`, each at 1440×900 and 1280×720. There were 0 page errors.
  - After Escape the 1px brass focus ring shows. After a mouse choice it does not, as the "keyboard focus only" ring rule requires.

**Code review:** no Critical findings, score 8.5/10.
- **Medium, A-R242-REVIEW-M1, needs B's ruling:** the same focus loss still happens when a fader, marker, loop brace or text field had focus. The timeline already blurs those elements on any mouse button, before the new capture runs. I confirmed this in the source but not in the browser. It existed before this round, and the code that does it is frozen, so I did not change it. B must decide whether a right press should skip that blur or whether focus should return to the blurred element.
- **Rejected:** a Low asking not to write "C round 242 PASS" in the doc status before C has checked. Lesson L28 and the task require that exact string.
- **Architecture note for B/root (proposal only):** keep the code as it is for now. If this menu-focus code is changed again, move its refs and the two handlers into one hook, `useGridMenuFocusReturn`.

Not run by me (C's rows): the clip-body case in the browser (I have only the GM39 unit test), the menu regression rows, the screen-text budget, the export hash, the auth checks and the full gate. The report is `a-round-242.md` in the loop folder, with logs and screenshots in `a-round-242/`; nothing was committed. Only this round's three files are done; SABA-B-11b stage 2b has not started.
